Heard Mr. Bharat Singh Pal, learned counsel for the applicants, Mr. Yogesh Kumar Srivastava,
learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been moved seeking quashing of the proceedings of Case No. 213 of 2014 (State Vs. Rajendra Prasad and other), arising out of charge sheet no.508/13 in Case Crime No.413 of 2013, under Sections 418, 420, 403, 506, 120B I.P.C., P.S. Khurza,
District-Bulandshahr, pending in the court of A.C.J.M., Khurza, Bulandshahr.

entities.text: State Vs. Rajendra Prasad and other)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
At the outset learned counsel for the applicants gave up his challenge to the aforesaid prayer and confined his submission requesting to grant some protection to the applicants to surrender before Rajendra Prasad @ Raj Narayan And ... vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53728177/
1 the concerned court below.

entities.text: Rajendra Prasad @ Raj Narayan And ... vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicants further stated at the Bar that he is not pressing any other prayer made in this application on merits and prayed that a direction may be issued to the concerned court below to consider and decide the bail application/surrender application of the applicants expeditiously.

Learned A.G.A. for the State of U.P. submits that in case the applicants are not pressing the relief as sought for by them on merits and want to surrender before the concerned court below, he has no objection in granting protection to them for a short period.

In view of above, considering the aforesaid alternative prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants, it is directed that the applicants shall file a surrender application before the concerned Court below on or before 30th May, 2023.

On receiving the surrender application, the Court concerned shall obtain instructions from the public prosecutor and fix a date for appearance/surrender of the applicants and for hearing the applicants on surrender application.
On the date fixed by the Court concerned, the applicants will have liberty to prefer a bail application and a copy of the same be provided to the public prosecutor.

In case, any such bail application is filed, the same shall be considered by the Court below along with the surrender application, on the date fixed, in accordance with law, with consent of parties, keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
For the period of 15 days from today or till the surrender application is decided, whichever is earlier,
no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
With the above observations and directions, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed off.
